entities.name: Imidazolonepropionase Q7MX82
observations: Exact sequence hash match to the 423-residue query; reviewed Swiss-Prot protein from Porphyromonas gingivalis W83.
Catalyzes hydrolytic cleavage of imidazolone-5-propanoate to N-formimidoyl-L-glutamate; EC 3.5.2.7.
Binds one Zn2+ or Fe3+ ion per subunit.
Annotated to the cytoplasm and L-histidine catabolic process.

entities.name: L-histidine degradation
observations: Imidazolonepropionase performs the third step of the universal L-histidine degradation pathway, producing N-formimidoyl-L-glutamate before conversion toward L-glutamate.

entities.name: Imidazolonepropionase sequence properties
observations: Query length 423 aa; estimated molecular weight 45,881 Da; theoretical pI 5.45; predicted net charge at pH 7 approximately -12.5.
Pfam matches: Amidohydro_1 and Amidohydro_3, consistent with an amidohydrolase-family enzyme.
